newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end down on CPMF tax, profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end down on CPMF tax, profit-taking.

text.p: Brazilian stocks reversed early gains to end down 0.57 percent, dropping mostly on speculation the government may not exempt stock trade from the new CPMF tax on financial transactions, brokers said.
"It now looks like there may not be an exemption from the CPMF after all, so that caused profit-taking," a dealer told Reuters.
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of 49 most-traded fell 392 points to close at 67,976 points on volume of 400 million reais.
